# GNK ASG — Public Chat Scope

Status: preparation only.

## Purpose

Define the public portal chat scope for GNK ASG Intelligence Desk.

## Public chat may help with

- portal navigation;
- GNK ASG Insights archive;
- public documents;
- market monitor sections;
- technology and AI pages;
- GNK DINAMO Ltd. public framework;
- contact guidance.

## Public chat should answer from

- published portal pages;
- public GNK ASG Insights articles;
- public document labels;
- visible portal sections.

## Public chat should not do

- create formal commitments;
- interpret private matters;
- replace primary documents;
- invent facts;
- answer outside published context.

## Recommended answer style

- concise;
- source-aware;
- corporate;
- clear about uncertainty;
- link back to the relevant page.

## Initial suggested prompts

- Show GNK ASG Insights
- Explain the Intelligence Desk
- Open public documents
- Explain the market monitor
- Show technology and AI content
- Explain the GNK DINAMO Ltd. framework
